newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Rebel mines kill eight in Sri Lanka.
newsitem.headline: Rebel mines kill eight in Sri Lanka.

text.p: Mines planted by separatist Tamil guerrillas killed seven civilians and a soldier on a crowded road in northern Sri Lanka on Wednesday, the Defence Ministry said.
The two mines exploded near a causeway linking Jaffna peninsula with the small island of Karaitivu, 320 km (200 miles) north of the capital Colombo, a ministry spokesman told Reuters.
The mines blew up when the road was crowded with civilians, military officials in the area said.
Two civilians and five soldiers were wounded, they said.
The Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE), who are fighting for a homeland for minority Tamils in this predominantly Sinhalese island's north and east, were not immediately available for comment.
Wednesday's explosions took place a day after another mine planted by rebels on an eastern road blew up a van, killing six civilians including two children.
The government says more than 50,000 people have died in the war, now in its 14th year. The LTTE say the toll is higher.
